ns2:course.label: Psych of Language
ns2:course.description: Survey of theory and research in the psychology of language; topics include relation of linguistics and psychology, language development, and influence of language on perception, memory, and thought. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Credit not given for both PSYC 425 and LING 425. Prerequisite: Six hours of psychology or consent of instructor.
